main.remarks: This interface defines the operational contracts of the ToolAspireHostBuilder.

property.name: Builder
property.remarks: The managed for distributed application composition.

method.name: BuildAspireHostOpenFactory
method.summary: Build the ToolAspireHost using a factory delegate. The factory bypasses reflection-based construction and is safe for NativeAOT.
method.param: Factory delegate that constructs the ToolAspireHost.

method.name: BuildAspireHostAsyncOpenFactory
method.summary: Build the ToolAspireHost Async using a factory delegate. The factory bypasses reflection-based construction and is safe for NativeAOT.
method.param: Factory delegate that constructs the ToolAspireHost.
method.returns: A Task that represents the asynchronous operation.

method.name: ConfigureToolAspireHost
method.remarks: Applies configuration to the built instance after construction.

method.name: ConfigureToolAspireHostAsync
method.param: Async configuration action for the built ToolAspireHost.
method.remarks: Applies configuration to the built instance after construction while preserving ordered execution with synchronous ToolAspireHost-configuration actions.

method.name: ConnectWithApplication
method.summary: Connect the built ToolAspireHost to managed application services.
method.remarks: Registers a shared in managed application services when a builder-owned Tool service provider is used. This registration is skipped for an externally supplied Tool service provider.

method.name: LinkLifetime
method.summary: Link the Tool host lifetime to managed application services.
method.remarks: Registers the host's shared in managed application services when a builder-owned Tool service provider is used. This registration is skipped for an externally supplied Tool service provider.

method.name: UseConsoleLifetime
method.summary: Use console lifetime behavior with the builder-owned Tool service provider.
method.remarks: When an external Tool service provider is supplied, the builder uses the host's default lifetime instead.

method.name: UseBuilderArguments
method.remarks: Replaces the current distributed application builder with a new builder created from the supplied arguments.

method.name: UseBuilderOptions
method.remarks: Replaces the current distributed application builder with a new builder created from the supplied options.
